This assistant proposes; it never writes a file and never calls a tool it was not offered.

I read the 0.2.0-draft schema, took the shape of the bundled minimal-expense-approval fixture, and encoded the reimbursement policy as one pack. My first draft named an outcome it never declared and `validate` refused it; the runtime's diagnostic was:

    JPS-SEMANTIC-UNRESOLVED-OUTCOME /rules/3/outcome: Outcome reference "escalate-to-finance" does not resolve to a declared outcome.

So the 1000 USD ceiling became an `escalate` exception rather than an outcome. `validate` reports the corrected draft valid, and a rehearsal evaluation over a 120.00 claim with a receipt reaches `approve`. I decide nothing here: the runtime's own report is quoted above, and this is a proposal for you to accept or reject.

outcomes.label: Approve
outcomes.description: The claim may be reimbursed without a human deciding it.

outcomes.label: Decline
outcomes.description: The claim is refused because the policy's receipt condition is not met.

rules.description: Approve a claim of 50 USD or less.
rules.rationale: The policy approves a claim of 50 USD or less outright.

rules.description: Approve a claim above 50 USD when a receipt is attached.
rules.rationale: Above 50 USD the policy approves only a claim carrying a receipt.

rules.description: Decline a claim above 50 USD with no receipt attached.
rules.rationale: Above 50 USD a claim without a receipt is declined.

exceptions.description: A claim above 1000 USD is escalated to finance instead of being decided here.

escalation.message: Decide this expense reimbursement claim by hand: it is above the 1000 USD ceiling, or a fact the policy needs is missing.

unknowns: The policy fixes the thresholds in USD but does not say what to do with a claim denominated in another currency; the pack reads /claim/amount as a decimal string and assumes the caller has already converted it.
"above 50" and "above 1000" are read as strictly greater-than, so a claim of exactly 1000.00 is decided here rather than escalated. The policy does not say.

Whether a receipt is attached is supplied as the prepared fact /claim/receiptAttached. The pack declares a `receipt` evidence requirement as a citation only (required: false) — nothing in the pack checks that the attached document is itself a valid receipt.
